primary_source.title: Bronze helmet of Chalcidian type
primary_source.museum_note: This example represents a variant in which the cheek pieces are hinged rather than in one continuous piece.
primary_source.source_role: Primary complete-depth and hinged-cheek construction lock.

front_structure_counterpart.title: Bronze helmet of Chalcidian type
front_structure_counterpart.source_role: Corroborating brow, eye-opening, nasal, and paired fixed-cheek geometry; its incised brow treatment is not an ornament reference.

multi_view_counterpart.title: Bronze helmet of the so-called Chalcidian type
multi_view_counterpart.source_role: Corroborating multi-view evidence for the complete bowl/back, fixed cheek counterparts, ear cutouts, facial opening, and neck edge. Archaeological breaks and corrosion are explicitly excluded.

additional_complete_object_consulted.title: Chalcidian-Type Helmet
additional_complete_object_consulted.museum_note: Curved cheekpieces attached by pins terminating in snake heads.
additional_complete_object_consulted.source_role: Complete museum corroboration for curved attached cheekpieces. The snake-head pin terminals are object-specific ornament and are not authorized for the plain roster target.
additional_complete_object_consulted.local_image_status: Official downloads were blocked by the museum site's browser challenge; no Walters image was saved.
